name: 再通知の日時を指定するシート
prompt:
Create a faithful static Japanese Slack reminder date/time selection sheet using the attached exact original screenshot crop for geometry, content hierarchy, colors and selected-state placement, and the Japanese native preview for exact Japanese copy and 390×562 bounds.

Recreate only the white rounded-top modal from the drag handle through the green confirmation button. No dimmed message background, phone status/navigation chrome, home indicator, footer or branding. The actual blue Youtube hyperlink is above this assigned crop; do not add it.

At the top, include a centered short gray drag handle and bold title 「リマインダーを設定」. Below a thin divider, list these five plain dark options, with generous source spacing and no dividers between them:
「30分後」
「1時間後」
「3時間後」
「明日の9:00」
「月曜日の9:00」
Then a thin divider and the plain dark custom option 「日時を指定」.

Below it, reproduce a four-column iOS wheel with five complete visible rows:
「5月30日(木)」 | 10 | 58 | 午前
「昨日」 | 11 | 59 | 午前
selected center row 「6月1日(土)」 | 12 | 00 | 午後
「6月2日(日)」 | 1 | 01 | 午後
「6月3日(月)」 | 2 | 02 | 午後
Use the original screenshot's wide rounded very light neutral-gray selected band, not the mint-green mock highlight. Make selected values bold near-black; adjacent values Meiryo Regular gray and gently faded toward top and bottom.

At the bottom, add one full-width rounded forest/Slack-green primary button with the exact white label 「リマインダーを設定」. Match the original crop's button height, margins and color. Keep the entire composition crisp, flat and legible on the white sheet. All modal options are actions, not hyperlinks; no component text has link metadata, so keep them dark or white on the green button and do not use blue.
reviewNotes: Layout and Japanese copy match; correct the visible gradient/texture on the green button in a second attempt.
reviewNotice: 画像生成候補。ネイティブ編集・実装・所有者承認とは別です。
